questions.stem: Areolar loose connective tissue underlying epithelium contains which cell combination?
options: B) Fibroblasts, Mast cells, Histocytes, Plasma cells
questions.answer: B) Fibroblasts, Mast cells, Histocytes, Plasma cells
questions.explanation: Areolar CT contains fibroblasts, mast cells, histocytes, plasma cells.

questions.stem: White adipose tissue differs from brown fat because white adipocytes are:
options: B) Monolocular for energy storage and insulation
questions.answer: B) Monolocular for energy storage and insulation
questions.explanation: White fat is monolocular for long-term energy storage.

questions.stem: Which fibrocartilaginous structure acts as a shock absorber between spinal vertebrae?
questions.explanation: Intervertebral discs contain fibrocartilage to absorb compression.

questions.stem: During skeletal muscle contraction, calcium ions bind directly to:
questions.explanation: Ca2+ binds Troponin C to shift Tropomyosin.

questions.stem: Ciliated ependymal neuroglial cells line brain ventricles to secrete and circulate:
questions.explanation: Ependymal cells line CNS ventricles to circulate CSF.

questions.stem: Which compound epithelium lines sweat gland ducts and pancreatic ducts?
questions.explanation: Stratified cuboidal lines sweat and pancreatic ducts.

questions.stem: Reticular white collagen CT forming liver and spleen internal scaffolding matrix is rich in:
questions.explanation: Type III collagen forms reticular framework of lymphoid organs.

questions.stem: Which plasma protein maintains blood osmotic pressure to prevent tissue edema?
questions.explanation: Albumin maintains capillary colloid osmotic pressure.

questions.stem: Fast-twitch white skeletal muscle fibres rely primarily on:
options: B) Anaerobic glycolysis with glycogen breakdown
questions.answer: B) Anaerobic glycolysis with glycogen breakdown
questions.explanation: White muscle relies on fast anaerobic glycolysis.

questions.stem: Which neurone structural type has one cyton and a single axon with NO dendrites?
questions.explanation: Unipolar neurones have 1 axon and no dendrites.
